title: Repeat after me:
description: God is realer than any fear that comes. I am divinely protected by God. I am loved by God without condition. By divine decree, nothing can ever happen that is not in my favour. Nothing ever moves me but His divine hand and guidance. May everyone answer to God.
content:
God is realer than any fear that comes.

I am divinely protected by God.

I am loved by God without condition.

By divine decree, nothing can ever happen that is not in my favour.

Nothing ever moves me but His divine hand and guidance.

May everyone answer to God.

content:
**JACK OF FACES** @JackOfFaces [2025-08-15](https://x.com/JackOfFaces/status/1956234150203285517)

Just your daily ego-shattering reminder that you live in an input/output system.

Whatever biases you feed to the universe through your belief system - it will keep giving you proof of those biases.

Why?

Because it wants your ego to grow by being right - a self-inflicted trap.

title: The Worst Thing You Have To Fight In This Life You Have To Fight Alone.
description: JACK OF FACES @JackOfFaces 2025-07-17https://x.com/JackOfFaces/status/1945871879761256941 The worst thing you have to fight in this life - you have to fight alone. Be it betrayal, temptation, grief, or a secret emptiness in your heart. In your most difficult task - no soul is able to help you. If mo...
content:
**JACK OF FACES** @JackOfFaces [2025-07-17](https://x.com/JackOfFaces/status/1945871879761256941)

The worst thing you have to fight in this life - you have to fight alone.

Be it betrayal, temptation, grief, or a secret emptiness in your heart.

In your most difficult task - no soul is able to help you.

 If more humans understood this, we would be far kinder to one another.

title: What is keeping you from experiencing miracles is your inability to access the miracle that was hidden within your heart.
description: Your mind opens portals. Your spirit maintains them. This war has no other battlefield than the collective heart of humanity.
content:
Your mind opens portals.

Your spirit maintains them.

This war has no other battlefield than the collective heart of humanity.
